about: Boss music and creature SFX (asset round 3). Downloaded as MP3, converted to OGG Vorbis (q5, 44.1 kHz stereo). Music was made loopable by cutting before any fade and cross-fading the last 1.5 s into the first 1.5 s (equal power), so the end runs straight into the start: import with loop=true (the .import files here set it). Not yet checked by ear: listen before shipping, especially whether the Abomination choir sings real words (it was asked for vowels only).

music.prompt_summary: velvet menace: walking upright bass, brushed jazz drums 132 bpm, muted trumpet and tenor sax hook, staccato string ostinatos, orchestral stabs, harpsichord

music.model: elevenlabs_music_v2 (50 s; the last 5 s faded out and were cut)
music.prompt_summary: brutal percussion: taiko, anvils, low toms 100 bpm, distorted sub booms, dissonant brass, wordless gregorian choir, horror string clusters

sfx.use: werewolf roar / Hollow Alpha (pitch down ~3 semitones); sync with werewolf_anim_roar at ~0.9 s
werewolf and vampire claw hits (heavy swipe 1.57 s, claw combo hits); boosted +16 dB, it came out quiet
werewolf pounce: whoosh then landing thud; start at takeoff (0.6 s)
vampire aggro / taunt / before a lunge
vampire lunge and Marcus dash (coat flutter)
Abomination slam at 1.67 s, grab-throw landing at 3.5 s
heavy deaths (werewolf death ~1.6 s, Marcus death ~2.9 s), knockdowns
